name: Engineering Drawing & Sketching
summary: The graphical language of engineering: freehand sketching, orthographic and pictorial views, sections, dimensions and reading drawings.

topics.name: Freehand sketching techniques: lines, circles and proportions
Pictorial views: isometric, oblique and perspective sketches
Multiview drawings, hidden lines and centre lines
Section views (full, half, offset, broken-out, revolved) and hatching conventions
Dimensioning rules and practices (ASME Y14.5 / ISO 129 basics)
Representing threads, fasteners and standard features
Drawing sheets: title blocks, scales, line types, notes and revisions
Assembly drawings, exploded views and bills of materials
Reading and interpreting real engineering drawings
